title: Record SIP money in a falling month: why a SIP suits a dip
description: Indians put a record Rs 32,490 crore into SIPs in September, a month when markets fell. Why a SIP is built for exactly that, worked out by code. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
